plan: A mage who upgrades his spells over the game and controls fights with his gravity field.
aSurveiller: His W (Gravity Field). Staying inside stuns you: get out of it immediately.
contrer: Get out of his W right away: it stuns you if you stay inside.
Avoid his E: his beam hits along a long line.
Engage him: he is fragile and immobile.

sorts.P: Upgrades his spells over the game.
sorts.Q: Strike that gives him a shield.

momentFort: Strong in the mid and late game.
